attestations_context_parent.name: attestations_context_parent
attestations_context_parent.value:
("attestations"."context" = 'application' and "attestations"."application_id" is not null and "attestations"."order_id" is null)
        or ("attestations"."context" = 'checkout' and "attestations"."application_id" is null and "attestations"."order_id" is not null)

compliance_cases_item_requires_order.name: compliance_cases_item_requires_order
compliance_cases_item_requires_order.value: "compliance_cases"."order_item_id" is null or "compliance_cases"."order_id" is not null

orders_money_safe.name: orders_money_safe
orders_money_safe.value:
"orders"."subtotal_minor" between 0 and $1
        and "orders"."tax_minor" between 0 and $2
        and "orders"."shipping_minor" between 0 and $3
        and "orders"."total_minor" between 0 and $4
